article.story: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- — Hannah Hidalgo scored 31 points, Jenica Lewis added 17 off the bench and Notre Dame rolled past Southern 95-47 on Wednesday night. Hidalgo, the national scoring leader at 28.3 points per game coming in, made 7 of 13 shots from the field and 16 of 18 free throws for the Fighting Irish. She had seven steals. Lewis, a freshman, buried five 3-pointers on the way to her fourth double-digit game of the season. Hidalgo had 12 points, four rebounds, three assists and three steals in the first half while Notre Dame built a 50-23 lead at intermission. A 16-0 run in the first quarter led to a 20-2 lead. Hidalgo scored 15 points in the third quarter and the Fighting Irish extended their lead to 71-35. The margin peaked at 95-46 after the Irish scored their last 12 points when Lewis and Isabella Ragone each hit two 3-pointers. The Irish (5-0) shot 51% overall, including 12 of 24 3-pointers and they made 23 of 27 free throws. Zaria Hurston scored 11 points for Southern (1-4). The Jaguars, the preseason favorites to win the Southland Conference, have 10 Power 4 teams on their schedule. Up next Notre Dame plays Davidson on Tuesday at the Battle 4 Atlantis. Southern plays Syracuse next Wednesday at the Puerto Rico Shootout. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
